%% Calibration deck: three frames the automatic Top Margin does not correct by their content

%% tools/calibrate_font_profile.py and tools/check_layout.py check it.
\setSlideVersion{1-0-0}
\SMManualTopMargin
\begin{standardframe}{Manual top margin: a list first}
	\begin{itemize}
		\item The first line sits on the Top Margin
		\item Second item
	\end{itemize}
\end{standardframe}
